note: the other door

note: band_type grade. One column asked three ways, gated on band_type

note: the branch before the leaf: algebra or geometry comes before simultaneous equations

note: 379 answers, so the cap keeps it quiet until the list is small enough to name one

note: the id decides who answers; the name is what is shown, shortened against the answers beside it

label: Question part
note: held behind Question number, so one paper's own convention is the only one on screen

label: What you need
note: a comma-list: compasses and the printed sheet at once

note: was "Paper code", which stopped being true when spec_code was split off. Defers to Exam board, so a board's own name is asked once

note: venues only, so it sits after the questions everything can answer

note: links only; same
